excerpt: necessity: if [p] is fully grounded in D, then □(∧D → p). The thesis concerns full grounds and the modal entailment of the grounded proposition by the full ground propositions.
overview: This formula is the article’s target proposition. It fixes the relevant sense of necessary grounding as modal entailment from full grounds, rather than as a claim that the grounding relation itself or some grounding relation must recur in every possible world.
title: Necessity Thesis Formula
